name: Arctic Dwarf
traits: The Inugaakalikurit are Small Humanoids (Dwarf). +4 Strength, −2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Darkvision 60 ft.
Small gives +1 on attacks and AC, +4 Hide, and −4 grapple. Use Small weapons and three-quarters of the Medium carrying limits.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Land speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework and a reactive check within 10 ft. An Arctic Dwarf can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+2 racial bonus on saves against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
Treat dwarven waraxes and urgroshes as martial weapons. +1 racial attack bonus against orcs and goblinoids. +4 dodge AC against giants. +2 racial Appraise and Craft bonuses for stone or metal.
Immune to cold. The player entry grants immunity as a racial trait and lists no Cold subtype or fire vulnerability.
Common, Dwarven, and the home-region language are automatic. The revised Great Glacier region adds Uluik and offers Aquan, Auran, Damaran, Draconic, and Giant as bonus languages.
Favored class Ranger. No racial Hit Dice. Level adjustment +2 gives ECL 3 at one class level.
This profile uses the 2003 playable traits with the 3.5 core Dwarf rules and the revised Great Glacier region.
